title: Brex feature rows
description: A centred headline and subtitle, then rows that alternate a lavender-grey illustration panel with a 36px heading, a grey paragraph and an orange arrow link. The panel sits left on odd rows and right on even rows on desktop; on phones the panel always comes first.
notes: media slots: one 486×358 illustration panel per row (a lavender-grey rounded surface)
rows are centred in a 1080px column
